description: Link one case-law decision from the corpus to the current matter, with an optional note. A decision that is not in the corpus is a 404; a decision already linked to this matter returns the existing link unchanged, note included, even when the matter is full, because re-linking adds nothing. The call is refused only when it would add a link past the matter's maximum. To link a selection at once, use the batch call instead of repeating this one.
